content:
Hi everyone, this is my first post, hopefully Im doing it right,

I'm currently a PhD in geometric topology, and I want to formalise something in my free time.
I have programming experience and have played some of the LEAN games.

My mathematical interests are geometric topology and abstract homotopy theory. I also have some basic experience in logic and number theory, although in this space I think they are probably accounted for.
If anyone has any interesting suggestions that might be actually helpful to the community I would love to hear.

Thanks for reading.
Welcome Riley, the Australian community grows perhaps !
